items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: I didn't go with Sydney a Vene, but Sydney a Vene left me was playing with me at the Hunt.

ctx.x: Gee, I never knew they had music. You all played on the JS Sydney a while too, didn't you?
No. The captain. I didn't go with Sydney a Vene, but Sydney a Vene left me was playing with me at the Hunt.
No, I mean, they both leave that Canal Street going to Resilient.
